words.definition: physical activity that you do to stay healthy
words.example: I do exercise every morning before work.

words.definition: a group of people who play a sport together
words.example: Our team won the football match.

words.definition: a sports game between two players or teams
words.example: We watched a tennis match on TV.

words.definition: to be the best or first in a game or competition
words.example: Did your team win the game?

words.definition: to not win a game or competition
words.example: I hate to lose, but I played well.

words.definition: to get a point in a game
words.example: He scored two goals in the match.

words.definition: a person who trains a sports team or player
words.example: The coach taught us new skills.

words.definition: a place with equipment for exercise
words.example: I go to the gym three times a week.

words.definition: to move fast using your legs
words.example: She runs five kilometers every day.

words.definition: to move through water using your arms and legs
words.example: We swim in the pool on weekends.

words.definition: to push your body up into the air
words.example: The athlete jumped very high.

words.definition: having a lot of physical power
words.example: You need strong legs to play football.

words.definition: well and not sick; good for your body
words.example: Sport helps you stay healthy.

words.definition: feeling that you need to rest or sleep
words.example: I was tired after the long race.

words.definition: to do something many times to get better at it
words.example: We practice every Tuesday and Thursday.

words.definition: an event where people try to win
words.example: She joined a swimming competition.

words.definition: a point scored in football, or something you want to achieve
words.example: He scored the winning goal.

words.definition: a round object used in many sports
words.example: The children played with a ball in the park.

words.definition: a competition to see who is fastest
words.example: He won the running race.

words.definition: to make your muscles longer before exercise
words.example: Always stretch before you run.

text: Many people enjoy sports because they help you stay healthy and strong. Every morning, my friend Anna does exercise before she goes to work. She likes to run in the park, and on weekends, she likes to swim at the local pool. Anna also plays for a football team. Last Saturday, her team had an important match against another team from the city. Before the game started, the players did some exercises to stretch their muscles. The coach told them to practice hard and play well together. During the match, Anna's team played very well. In the second half, she scored a goal, and the crowd was very happy. Her team won the match three to one! After the game, Anna felt tired but happy. She said that sport is not only about winning; it is also about having fun with friends. Next month, Anna wants to join a running race in her city. She hopes to enter more competitions this year and become even stronger. Sport makes her feel good every day.
